title: A billable invoice with a no-charge line shows the No Charge lines block
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure AccountingHub is enabled for the organization and the test location has no QuickBooks Online connection.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new invoiced work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A, with line 1 done by technician A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Complete, billable, with line 1 billable and line 2 of 1.5 hours marked No Charge under Comeback with one stock part costing $40.00 and work order 2's line 1 as its original.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Create invoice.
  3. Open Accounting > Sales > Invoices.
  4. Open work order 1's invoice record.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The invoice is created.

Step 3:

  • The invoice is listed as an ordinary invoice with its revenue.

Step 4:

  • A "No Charge lines" block shows line 2 with its number and title, Comeback, work order 2 and its line 1, technician A, 1.5 hours, parts cost $40.00 and 6440 Comeback Expense.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11765 (Story 8, AccountingHub, the closed work order and its parts cost), story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S8-R7: “An invoice of a billable work order with no-charge lines (Story 12) reaches the hub as an ordinary invoice record with its revenue and receivable on the billable lines. The record carries a "No Charge lines" block: line number and title, category, original work order and line, original technician, hours, parts cost, expense account. The posting splits the parts cost: billable lines to the parts cost of goods sold account as today, each no-charge line to its category's mapping row (S6-R1). When a no-charge line's category row is empty, the invoice, its revenue and its receivable post at once and only that line's cost entries are held, with the reason "No Charge: [Category] row not mapped", until the row is mapped (S8-N2); a reversal that withdraws them marks them Dismissed (S4-R3). In Journal Entries the source of a no-charge line's entry reads "No Charge line".”
  • S12-R11: “Reports and the dashboard follow Story 9 (S9-R1, S9-R2, S9-R3, S9-R7, S9-R8, S9-R11 to S9-R13); the Open API follows Story 11; the hub record follows S8-R7.”
